content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hi,

I hope you’re well. Before I sign the agreement, I’d like to clarify a few points:
- The relevant clause currently states that I shall perform any additional services the Client reasonably requests during the Term at no additional charge. This could require unlimited extra work without compensation. I propose that additional services be performed only if the parties agree in writing to the scope and any applicable additional fees.
- The agreement allows the Client to request unlimited revisions until fully satisfied with each Deliverable. Unlimited revisions may consume excessive time and resources. I suggest limiting revisions to the scope of the Deliverable, with a set number of revisions per Deliverable, after which any further changes would be handled through a mutually agreed change order and fee.
- The revision allowance is listed as "unlimited." Unlimited changes can impact schedule and cost. I recommend limiting the revision allowance to a maximum of three revision cycles per Deliverable, unless additional revisions are agreed upon in writing and compensated.

Please let me know if these adjustments work for you.

Thank you for your understanding.

Best regards
